description: PR #882 was reported as T0 with missing scope/linkage despite 16 changed files and 1300+ additions.
expected: Medium or large feature PRs should infer appropriate T2/T3 tier from changed-file count, cross-module/layer signals, feature branch/title/body signals, and should surface design/feature linkage guidance without pretending the PR is T0.
non_goals: Do not restart production runtime services without explicit approval.
title: PR Quality treats large feature PRs as T0 and misses linkage/scope

recommendations: Use compact success output; request full JSON only for failures or diagnostics.
Run targeted validation first, then final gates once the patch is stable.
Batch compatible workflow/CI/docs changes into one PR with per-issue evidence.
Keep validation_center_backend only when the changed files actually affect Validation Center.
